description: Windows cold-path helper for Node, which cannot call LockFileEx. One helper process per held lock: it takes the lock in its own process, keeps it until Node terminates it, and runs borrowed children on request. Node and the helper talk through files in a private work directory, never through stdin, so synchronous Node code can wait without a turning event loop.

exactlyOne.meaning: attempts until N milliseconds elapsed (N integer >= 1)

optional.meaning: reject other recorded kinds under the kernel lock before ordinary cleanup
predecessor kill wait and the bound for emptying a borrow job on parent death; source lock.predecessorKillWaitMs

workDir.owner: Node creates a private directory os.tmpdir()/fgos-lock-hold-<pid>-<seq>-<rand>/ and removes it after release
workDir.writeRule: every file below is written as a temp file then renamed into place; readers never see a partial file

files.ready.json: written by the helper once acquire has an answer: the same result shapes as lock-fd (acquired, held, timeout, unavailable, error) plus helperPid
files.req-<n>.json: written by Node: { op: "borrow", argv: string[], cwd: string, env: string map, stdin: "null" } or { op: "cancel", n: integer }
files.started-<n>.json: written by the helper: { pid }, the borrowed child's Windows pid
files.out-<n>.log: the child's stdout, appended as it writes
files.err-<n>.log: the child's stderr, appended as it writes
files.result-<n>.json: written by the helper after the borrow ended: { exit, leftoversKilled } or { error: <name> }, names: borrow-busy, borrow-leftover-pending (an earlier borrow left processes it could not end; its record is kept), borrow-leftover-not-killed, borrow-spawn-failed, borrow-spec-invalid, request-unknown, request-unreadable

workDir.n: request number, an integer starting at 1; the helper handles one borrow at a time and answers a second with result { error: "borrow-busy" }

declareDomain: request {op: declare-domain, domain: predecessor.v1 record}: the idle helper validates its acquired exclusive handle and writes the domain before answering {result: declared}. The supervisor requires this acknowledgement before GO; helper death cannot authorize a late producer
clearDomain: request {op: clear-domain}: the idle helper calls handle.clear_domain() and returns {result: cleared} or a named error; failure preserves the record
stdio: stdin ignored; stdout and stderr go to files, so a held lock never keeps the caller's event loop alive

lifetime.poll: the helper polls req-* every 5 ms and watches its parent's handle
lifetime.release: Node terminates the helper (the lock is free right after) and waits a bounded time for its exit; the error name when that bound passes is lock-release-stuck
lifetime.parentDeath: terminate any borrow job at once, wait for the job view to be empty up to K, unlock, exit
lifetime.noOtherExit: the helper never exits on its own while it holds the lock

exitCodes.0: ended by parent death after a clean release of the domain
exitCodes.3: protocol mismatch (result error, code host-version-mismatch; --protocol absent or != 1)

invariants: the lock handle is never inheritable and never duplicated into the borrowed child
the helper unlocks explicitly before closing the handle
on held, timeout and unavailable the helper holds no lock when it exits
